text:
Sam: Hey team — I'm the primary for next week (Mon 9am-5pm PT). I'd like to schedule two shadow sessions for a new on-call handoff: one to walk through paging -> mitigation -> customer comms, and one green run through the common playbooks. Who's available Tue/Wed? Also flagging weekend coverage: I think there's a potential gap Fri 22:00-02:00 PT. cc @OpsCoach :wave:
oncall-bot: scheduled-rotation-bot: Heads up — primary assignment updated: Sam assigned 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12. Rotation page: https://redwood.internal/rota/teams/oncall (view-only). Reminder: please book shadow sessions in the "Oncall Shadowing" calendar event series.

Priya: I can take Tue 11-12 PT for a shadow session. I can cover paging basics and the triage checklist. :thumbsup:

Jules: I can do Wed 08:30-09:30 PT. I'll demo the customer-impact triage flow and how we run quick mitigations (circuit breaker, model-fallback). Also happy to show the console metrics panels for latency/cost spikes.

Marta: Quick note — Friday night currently only has EMEA primary from 22:00 PT to 02:00 PT; that's a weak overlap with the US follow-on. If we expect higher traffic (marketing send etc.) we should either swap or add the contract responder. I'm free to swap one evening if needed.

OpsCoach: Great — thanks for flagging. Here's a short on-call handoff checklist and a runbook pointer you can paste into the calendar event or handoff doc:

```
Handoff checklist (short):
- Current incidents: list open incident IDs and customer impact
- Pager escalation: severity mapping (sev1 = page primary + escalate to oncall lead within 5m)
- Key contacts: CS escalation + platform ops
- Quick mitigations: toggle feature flag, redirect traffic to fallback model, scale pool
- Post-shift: update incidents.md, add any follow-up tasks to the sprint board
- Shadowing agenda: 15m paging mechanics, 30m runbook walkthrough, 15m hands-on practice
Runbook links:
- Paging & escalations: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging
- Model fallback & autoscale: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback
- Incident comms template: https://redwood.internal/templates/incident-comm
Commands to know:
- Check queue length: `./scripts/check_queue.sh --env prod`
- Trigger fallback: `rwctl route set --model rwd-small --traffic 100` (use with care)
- Dump logs: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --tail 200`
```

OpsCoach: Also, for onboarding shadows, please ensure the new oncaller reviews the mini-eval we run after the shadow session (link included in the calendar event). That eval captures confidence on paging, mitigations, runbook lookup.

Priya: Will add the calendar invites now. I'll attach the short checklist to the event and include the runbook links.

Jules: I'll prepare a short demo deck and a sample incident we can simulate (low-risk replay using staging traces). If anyone wants to join both sessions, feel free.

Sam: Awesome — thanks all. For the weekend gap Marta mentioned, let's decide by EOD Wed: either swap Fri evening or ask contract responder. If no objections I'll post the swap request in #schedules. My preferred slack for contact during shadow: @Sam (DM) — I'll only escalate to pager for sev1/2.

Marta: I'll block Fri evening in my calendar as tentative and we can confirm after Wed. Happy to take the swap if needed.

oncall-bot: incident-bot: FYI — there are no active sev1 incidents at the moment. Current open tickets: INC-2026-114 (monitoring-only), INC-2026-117 (customer reported latency).

Sam: OK closing loop — booked Tue 11-12 PT with Priya, Wed 08:30-09:30 PT with Jules, and added the handoff checklist to the calendar events. I'll update the handoff doc with the pager escalation matrix and my contact details. Thanks everyone :pray:
